scope.matched_metadata_only: Current aggregate session minutes and timezone; no prospectively versioned cash-session open/close boundaries for the historical M5 interval

finding: The accepted M5 development data and persisted structural subset do not establish historical per-symbol cash-session boundaries required by the frozen C006 first completed cash-session bar law. Even the three overlapping products expose aggregate current weekly minutes, not historical open/close flags. Deriving the event law by assuming current hours or filling calendar gaps would break causal validity.
